goals: Verify the comprehensive functionality of the superhero game API, including user authentication, character progression, in-game actions, and interactions between hero and villain roles.
activities: Sign up a new hero user with credentials.
Sign up a new villain user with credentials.
Log in the hero user.
Log in the villain user.
Get the hero's base information.
Upgrade the hero's base security defenses.
Start a mission for the hero, 'Stop Bank Robbery'.
Hero initiates a battle against a villain.
Get a list of nearby players for the hero.
Hero recruits a sidekick.
Villain recruits a minion.
Get the game map, including players and events, as the hero.
Hero attacks a territory.
Get the hero's influence score.
Hero invests money.
Get a list of available items from the market for the hero.
Get market items, then buy the first available item as the hero.
Villain creates a 'Cyber Attack' event in Downtown.
Hero defends against the created event.
Get the global leaderboard as the hero.
